description: Nivqo Manager 2.2.0 正式版：升級修補器至 Morphe Patcher 2.0.1，內建 HushFacebook 0.19.0（105 個補丁）及 HushMessenger 0.27.0（66 個補丁），共 171 個補丁。保留繁體中文／English／跟隨系統、Messenger 按鈕與離線核心，改善更新檢查提示。Facebook 584.0.0.51.56、Messenger 584.1.0.61.98 需使用相容原版 APK 重新修補。 English: Upgrades the patcher to Morphe Patcher 2.0.1 with Facebook 0.19.0 (105 patches), Messenger 0.27.0 (66 patches), combined 171 patches, localized UI, preserved Messenger routing and offline patch bundles.
